title: Signet Vouch — a private check for your calls

Explicit two-root public link compatibility; vault/device credentials remain origin-bound. No redirect, account, message API, outbound fetch, content store or relay. Existing installed native apps are unchanged.

Separate two-origin video journey: real VP8/H264 encoder/RTP/decoder, simulated screens/cameras, camera permission granted to local ICE fixture, host candidates only. Neither is a physical call/biometric trial.
notice_alignment: Provider-specific hosting notice and recovery guidance published at both origins. Cloudflare operational/security processing remains possible; NEL headers observed. Existing UK-law applications remain the documented [U] assessment.

migration: Existing storage/passkeys stay at the original origin. Full recovery backup needs its passphrase and new-origin unlock enrolment. Selected-person copy excludes groups, unfinished state and unlock. Keep the original until verified.
